item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission investigated whether serious misconduct occurred in the award of a security services tender by the Mid West Ports Authority.
item.support: which led to the commencement of an investigation to determine whether serious misconduct had or may have occurred

item.text: The Commission identified risks arising from departures from ordinary procurement and tender procedures.
item.support: the Commission's investigation identified several serious misconduct risks regarding the deviation from standard procurement and tender procedures during the process.

item.text: The Commission made no serious misconduct finding against any employee of the authority and reported the risks to assist public authorities with prevention.
item.support: did not make a finding of serious misconduct against any MWPA employee.
